newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch -- March 7.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch -- March 7.

text.p: * Intel Corp was slightly higher in after-hours trading Thursday, up 1/4 at 145-5/8.

* Atmel Corp said it expects revenues for the first quarter to be as much as 10 percent lower than the $281.1 million in the 1996 fourth quarter. As a result, the company said it expects first quarter profits to be impacted. The stock closed at 31-1/2 Thursday.

* H.F. Ahmanson & Co said Thursday it was taking legal action to require Great Western Financial Corp, which is being pursued by both Ahmanson and Washington Mutual Savings Bank, to comply with its fiduciary duties and treat all takeover offers on the same basis. Great Western has agreed to merge with Washington Mutual.
Ahmanson closed at 40-3/4. Great Western closed at 46-3/4. Washington Mutual closed at 53.
* Eli Lilly, which dropped 2-1/2 to 86-5/8 Thursday, rose to 87 in London after issuing a statement defending its new antipsychotic drug Zyprexa.
